editorial:
Imagine heading to a quiet science meeting in the snowy Alps, only to find out the place is hiding some scary secrets. You follow Johannes, a physics expert who is just trying to do his job, but things get weird fast. He meets a jazz pianist named Karin who seems to know way too much about his private life. The whole mood feels like a puzzle where every piece you find leads to another question. It is a slow burn that keeps you guessing if what you are seeing is real or just in his head.

Some parts might feel a bit slow if you want non-stop action, but the twists make the wait worth it. If you enjoy movies that mess with your mind, you will love this one.
endingExplained: You find out that the whole story is about a loop and parallel versions of the same person. Johannes discovers that the deaths and the strange events are tied to a scientific experiment gone wrong. Karin is actually a key part of this cycle. In the end, it is revealed that he is stuck in a repeating pattern of time. He finally understands the truth about his existence just as the cycle resets once again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves mind-bending mysteries and puzzles.
